_about: 徐州的差事 (design.md § 差事). 接下 at the giver; 交差 wherever the player stands, the moment the count is met — they never walk back.

say.zh: 搭把手，把船拖上岸——大水还要涨。拖完了，这袋干粮和三块灵石你带上山：灵石是你爹当年存在我这儿的。
say.en: Lend a hand and drag the boat up the bank — the flood is still rising. Then take this bag of rations and three spirit stones up the mountain: the stones are what your father left with me, years ago.

done.zh: 船上了岸。渡叔把干粮和三块灵石塞进你手里，没再多说。
done.en: The boat is up the bank. Du Shu presses the rations and the three stones into your hands and says nothing more.

say.zh: 藏经阁漏雨。梯子前天摔断了，你自己想办法。修好了，记你五块灵石。
say.en: The scripture hall leaks. The ladder broke the day before yesterday — find your own way up. Mend it and I'll book you five spirit stones.

done.zh: 你没用梯子，用了渔网和一根竹竿。周衡看了半天：「……能用就行。」
done.en: No ladder: a fishing net and a bamboo pole. Zhou Heng looks at it a long while. "…It works. That will do."

who.en: the old man at the market

say.zh: 小友且慢。老朽咳了半月，市上灵芝三十灵石一株，买不起。你若带一株来，这柄竹剑归你。
say.en: A moment, friend. I have coughed for half a month, and lingzhi costs thirty stones here. Bring me one and this bamboo sword is yours.

who.en: the old man at the market

say.zh: 药是好了。可采药的路断了——凫丽山有蠪侄，九尾九首，见人就扑。你降了它，我再谢你。
say.en: The cough is mended, but the herb road is shut: a Longzhi haunts Mount Fuli, nine tails and nine heads, and it leaps at anyone. Subdue it and I will thank you properly.

who.en: a fisherman on the north bank

say.zh: 上游吕梁洪，水悬三十仞，流沫四十里。孔夫子在那儿见过一个泅水的老丈，说他懂道。你去看一眼，回来讲给我听。
say.en: Upstream at Lvliang the water falls thirty fathoms and foams for forty li. Confucius saw an old man swim it there and said he knew the Way. Go look, and tell me.

seen.zh: 洪口水悬三十仞，白沫奔出四十里。浪心里竟有个老丈，披发而泅，出没如常，上岸时还哼着歌。问他可有道，他只说：从水之道，不为私焉。
seen.en: The water falls thirty fathoms and foams for forty li. In the heart of it an old man swims, hair loose, in and out of the flood as if it were a pond, and climbs out singing. Asked if he has a Way, he says only: I follow the water's way and add nothing of my own.

say.zh: 这山上八味灵草，配得齐才成丹。我年纪大了，眼花认不全。你替我配一炉。
say.en: Eight spirit herbs grow on this hill, and only the full eight make a pill. My eyes are old. Pair a set for me.

say.zh: {弟妹}。修仙之人，最要紧的是什么？——是不丢东西。药园上个月丢了灵草三十七株，这个月三十八株。多了一株：它在进步。此乃药园巡夜令，持此令者，夜入药园，无人敢拦。贼？贼不认字。灯油，外门每人每月半根。另一半，记账。
say.en: Junior. What matters most to one who cultivates? — Not losing things. The herb garden lost thirty-seven plants last month, thirty-eight this month. One more: it is improving. This is the night-watch token; whoever holds it may enter the garden at night and none will stop them. The thief? The thief cannot read. Lamp oil: half a candle a month per outer disciple. The other half goes in the ledger.

seen.zh: 子时的药园一片银白。最里面，那株最贵的紫玉参旁边，「咔嚓」一声。
seen.en: The herb garden at midnight, silver-white. At the far end, by the costliest purple jade ginseng: crunch.

done.zh: 周衡看了看那团打呼的红毛，又看了看你，提笔写下一行：「药园：灵草损失三十八株。入账：灵兽一只。」他长长地舒了一口气：「账平了。」巡夜有功，赏灵石——他一块一块地数——十块。「记账。」
done.en: Zhou Heng looks at the snoring ball of red fur, then at you, and writes a line: "Herb garden: thirty-eight plants lost. Received: one spirit beast." He lets out a long breath. "The books balance." A reward for the watch — he counts them out one by one — ten stones. "Entered in the ledger."

say.zh: 外门穷，巡夜没有工钱。不过药园每个月要拔一回残株：虫咬的，长歪的，灵气散了一半的。往年都是扔。以后，扔给你。——垃圾，也是账。你那只畜生鼻子灵，让它闻一闻，哪几株还能入炉。
say.en: The outer court is poor; the night watch pays nothing. But every month the garden is weeded of its culls: bitten by worms, grown crooked, half their spirit gone. We always threw them out. From now on, we throw them to you. — Rubbish is accounts too. That beast of yours has a good nose; let it sniff out which ones can still go in a furnace.

done.zh: 小狰的鼻子一抽一抽，从一堆残株里拱出八味还能用的。炉盖上的小兽睁开一只眼，又闭上了——像是在说：勉强。炉底躺着一颗聚气丹。
done.en: Little Zheng's nose twitches, and from the heap of culls it roots out eight herbs still good. The little beast on the furnace lid opens one eye and closes it — as if to say: passable. At the bottom of the furnace lies a Gathering pill.

say.zh: {兄姐}……我娘给我缝的护身符……缝了三个晚上……马小宝说它土，一扯，碎成了七块……你、你手巧吗？我娘说，戴着它，大比能赢一场。一场就够了。
say.en: Um… my mother sewed me this charm… three nights she sewed it… Ma Xiaobao said it was ugly and tore it — seven pieces… are you… are you good with your hands? My mother says with it on I'll win one round at the contest. One round is enough.

done.zh: 七块碎布拼回了一只护身符。孙二狗把它系回腰上，系了三道，又摸了三遍。「{兄姐}……你是好人。」
done.en: Seven scraps pieced back into a charm. Sun Ergou ties it at his waist, three knots, and touches it three times. "You're… a good person."

say.zh: （翻开小本子）九月初一，{name}，下下之资。地图，利息两块。——你没钱。那就跑腿抵：买两根萝卜，再替我去渡口，给渡叔捎句话。利息，一笔一笔地还。
say.en: (opening the little notebook) First of the ninth month: {name}, bottom of the class. The map: two stones' interest. — You've no money. Then work it off: buy two radishes, and run down to the ferry with a word for Du Shu. Interest gets paid one entry at a time.

done.zh: 阿禾接过萝卜，在本子上划掉一行，又写了一行，没告诉你写的什么。临走，{伴·她}塞给你一张符，墨还没干：「大比那天带着。我押你。」
done.en: Ah He takes the radishes, crosses out one line in the notebook and writes another — and doesn't tell you what. Leaving, Ah He presses a talisman on you, the ink still wet: "Bring it to the contest. I'm betting on you."
